section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种基因工程生物培养箱，包括壳体，所述壳体内腔的两侧均纵向固定连接有三个结构相同的托板，相邻两个托板之间设置有放置板，所述放置板的两侧分别延伸至相邻两个托板的内腔，所述托板的前侧固定连接有与放置板相适配的锁紧机构，所述锁紧机构的数量与托板相同，相邻两个锁紧机构之间设置有位于放置板底部的推动机构。本实用新型通过锁紧机构的设置，使用锁紧机构将放置板从托板的内腔拆下取出进行清洁，从而对放置板表面的残留物和有害物质进行清理，使得放置板表面保持干净整洁，进而保证了生物培养的质量，提高培养效率，该基因工程生物培养箱，具备方便拆卸从而方便清洁的优点。

The utility model discloses a genetic engineering biological incubator, which comprises a housin, the layer board that the equal vertical fixedly connected with three structure in both sides of casing inner chamber is the same is provided with between two adjacent layer boards and places the board, the both sides of placing the board extend to the inner chamber of two adjacent layer boards respectively, the front side fixedly connected with of layer board and the locking mechanism who places the looks adaptation, locking mechanism's quantity is the same with the layer board, is provided with the pushing mechanism who is located and places the bottom plate between two adjacent locking mechanism. The utility model discloses a locking mechanism's setting uses locking mechanism to pull down the inner chamber of placing the board from the layer board and takes out and clean to the residue and the harmful substance of placing the board surface clear up, make and place the board surface and keep clean and tidy, and then guaranteed biological quality of cultivateing, improve cultivation efficiency, thereby this genetic engineering biological incubator possesses convenient dismantlement convenient clear advantage.

Biological incubator of genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a genetic engineering biological incubator.

Background

The gene engineering technology is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, and is characterized by that it uses molecular genetics as theoretical basis, and uses the modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means, and makes the genes with different sources according to the predesigned blueprint to construct hybrid DNA molecule in vitro, then introduces it into living cell to change the original genetic characteristics of organism, obtain new variety and produce new product, and said gene engineering technology provides a powerful means for researching gene structure and function.

Need use biological incubator in genetic engineering, but the inconvenient dismantlement of placing the baffle in traditional biological incubator, inconvenient more clean, in long-time use, can deposit dust and residual on the baffle, will breed harmful substance for a long time, influence biological quality of cultivateing.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a genetic engineering biological incubator thereby possesses the convenient clear advantage of dismantling, has solved the inconvenient dismantlement of placing the baffle in traditional biological incubator, and is inconvenient clean more, in long-time use, can produce the dust on the baffle in addition the residue, will breed harmful substance for a long time, influences the problem of biological quality of cultivateing.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a genetic engineering biological incubator comprises a shell, wherein two sides of an inner cavity of the shell are longitudinally and fixedly connected with three supporting plates with the same structure, a placing plate is arranged between every two adjacent supporting plates, two sides of the placing plate respectively extend to the inner cavities of the two adjacent supporting plates, the front side of each supporting plate is fixedly connected with a locking mechanism matched with the placing plate, the number of the locking mechanisms is the same as that of the supporting plates, a pushing mechanism positioned at the bottom of the placing plate is arranged between every two adjacent locking mechanisms, two ends of the pushing mechanism respectively penetrate through the inner cavities of the two adjacent locking mechanisms and are in threaded connection with the locking mechanisms, each locking mechanism comprises a fixed block fixedly connected to the front side of the corresponding supporting plate, the top and the bottom of the left side of the fixed block are respectively provided with a movable groove and a penetrating cavity, the right side of the inner cavity of the movable groove, the left end of the moving pin extends out of the inner cavity of the moving groove and is fixedly connected with a lock pin, the left side of the inner cavity of the through cavity is slidably connected with a push rod, the left end of the push rod extends out of the inner cavity of the through cavity and is fixedly connected with the lock pin, one end, close to the pushing mechanism, of the push rod is matched with the pushing mechanism, and one side, far away from the moving pin, of the lock pin penetrates into the placing plate.

Preferably, the layer board is including fixing the diaphragm on shells inner wall, the mounting groove with placing the looks adaptation is seted up on the right side of diaphragm, the pulley groove has been seted up on the left side of mounting groove inner chamber, the inner chamber of pulley groove rotates through the pivot to be connected with place the pulley of looks adaptation.

Preferably, the two ends of the front side of the bottom of the placing plate are provided with grooves matched with the lock pins, and the grooves are located on the outer side of the supporting plate.

Preferably, pushing mechanism includes the screw thread spare of threaded connection at the fixed block inner chamber, sets up the rectangle dwang between two adjacent screw thread spares, the both ends of rectangle dwang run through respectively to the inner chamber of two adjacent screw thread spares and with screw thread spare sliding connection.

Preferably, the inner wall of the right side of the cavity in the penetrating cavity is a threaded surface matched with the threaded part, and the inner wall of the left side of the cavity in the penetrating cavity is a smooth surface matched with the push rod.

Preferably, the front side of the housing is hinged with a door plate, and the width and the height of the door plate are the same as those of the housing.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

1. the utility model discloses a locking mechanism's setting, use locking mechanism will place the board and pull down from the inner chamber of layer board and take out cleanly, thereby the residue and the harmful substance to placing the board surface are cleared up, make and place the board surface and keep clean and tidy, and then the quality of biological cultivation has been guaranteed, improve cultivation efficiency, this genetic engineering biological incubator, thereby possess convenient clear advantage of dismantling, the inconvenient dismantlement of placing the baffle in having solved traditional biological incubator, more inconvenient cleanness, in long-time use, can produce the dust on the baffle and have the residue in addition, will breed harmful substance for a long time, influence the problem of biological cultivation's quality.

2. The utility model discloses a setting of pulley, place the board in the installation and dismantle when placing the board more laborsaving, also more easily will place the board and take out, the person of facilitating the use operation.

3. The utility model discloses a pushing mechanism's setting rotates the rectangle dwang, and the screw spare through both sides promotes the lockpin to the outside and with place the board separation, uses portably, easy to operate, and then the person of facilitating the use uses.
